name: neurodrive-city
description: An editable virtual city where self-driving cars learn to drive with a from-scratch neural network and evolution, in 2D and 3D.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.engine.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run e2e
scripts.deploy:cf: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.158.0 pages deploy dist --project-name neurodrive-city --branch main
